1. (Previously presented) A travel assistance method for a vehicle, the method comprising:determining whether a route-following lane change along a set travel route can be assisted with autonomous lane change control;
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change can be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, autonomously controlling the vehicle to make the route- following lane change in a first direction; and
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, notifying a driver that the route-following lane change cannot be made with the autonomous lane change control, and prohibiting the autonomous lane change control from assisting a lane change in a second direction opposite to the first direction even in a case where an operation by the driver would otherwise cause the autonomous lane change control to assist with the lane change in the second direction.
2. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 1, further comprising:determining whether to satisfy execution conditions;
in response to a determination that the execution conditions are satisfied, determining that the route-following lane change can be assisted with the autonomous lane change control; and
in response to a determination that the execution conditions are not satisfied, determining that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control.
3. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 2, wherein the execution conditions include a condition that high-precision map information is available for a road on which the vehicle travels from start to completion of the lane change with the autonomous lane change control.
4. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 2, wherein the execution conditions include at least one of:
a condition that a radius of curvature of a road on which the vehicle travels from start to completion of the lane change with the autonomous lane change control is a predetermined value or more;
a condition that the road is not registered in high-precision map information as a road on which the lane change with the autonomous lane change control cannot be made;
a condition that a behavior of the vehicle is within a range in which the behavior can be controlled with the autonomous lane change control during execution of the lane change with the autonomous lane change control; or a condition that a traveling speed of the vehicle is within a predetermined range.
5. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 4, wherein the range is set at least by one of acceleration, deceleration, or lateral acceleration of the vehicle.
6. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 2, wherein the execution conditions include at least one of:a condition that when a first road on which the vehicle would travel after completion of the route-following lane change merges with a second road ahead of the vehicle in a traveling direction, a distance from a completion position of the route-following lane change to a merging position of the first and second roads is a predetermined distance or less, and a speed limit of the first road is set lower than a speed limit of a road on which the vehicle is traveling when starting the route-following lane change; or a condition that when an intersection is present ahead of the vehicle in the traveling direction on the first road on which the vehicle would travel after completion of the route- following lane change, a distance from the completion position of the route-following lane change to the intersection is a predetermined distance or less.
7. (Previously presented) A travel assistance device for a vehicle, comprising:a memory storing instructions; and
a processor to execute the stored instructions to:
determine whether a route-following lane change along a set travel route can be assisted with autonomous lane change control;
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change can be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, autonomously control the vehicle to make the route-following lane change in a first direction; and
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, notify a driver that the route-following lane change cannot be made with the autonomous lane change control, and prohibit the autonomous lane change control from assisting a lane change in a second direction opposite to the first direction even in a case where an operation by the driver would otherwise cause the autonomous lane change control to assist with the lane change in the second direction.
8. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 1, wherein in response to a determination that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, overtaking assist control is not executed even in a case of satisfying a condition for starting the overtaking assist control for overtaking a preceding vehicle with an autonomous travel by autonomous travel control.
9. (Canceled)
10. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the [[allvehicle according to claim 1, further comprising:when performing the route-following lane change, determine whether the route-following lane change can be assisted with the autonomous lane change control from a shape of a road that is preliminarily registered in map information; or in response to a determination that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control from the shape of the road, not execute the lane change with the autonomous lane change control from a current position of the vehicle to a position at which the vehicle can no longer execute the lane change with the route-following lane change.
11. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the vehicle of claim 1, wherein the autonomous lane change control is prohibited from assisting the lane change in the second direction until the vehicle passes a position where the route-following lane change in the first direction would have been made.
12. (Currently amended) The travel assistance method for the vehicle of claim 1, wherein the autonomous lane change control is prohibited from assisting the lane change in the second direction until the route-following lane change in the first direction is made in a manual operation by the driver of the vehicle.
13. (Currently amended) A travel assistance device for a vehicle, comprising:a memory storing instructions; and
a processor to execute the stored instructions to:
determine whether a route-following lane change along a set travel route can be assisted with autonomous lane change control;
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change can be assisted with the autonomous lane change control, autonomously control the vehicle to make the route-following lane change in a first direction; and
in response to a determination that the route-following lane change cannot be assisted with the autonomous lane change control and a determination that an input was received from a driver of the vehicle indicating for the autonomous lane change control to assist with a lane change in a second direction opposite the first direction, prohibitprevent the autonomous lane change control from assisting with the lane change in the second direction.
